name: Mighty Crown: Empire of Gold

features.name: Empire Bonus
features.description: Three Bonus symbols turn into wilds and start the bonus game.

features.name: Stacking multipliers
features.description: If wilds cover every position, each awards x1 to x5, for a total multiplier of up to x15.

features.name: Chance Level
features.description: A higher-bet option that raises the chance of triggering the bonus.

review:
A classic three-reel, five-line game with an ancient-gold theme. No hold-and-win here, just one simple bonus.

Three Bonus symbols open the Empire Bonus, where each Bonus symbol becomes a wild. Cover every position and each wild awards x1 to x5, stacking to a total of up to x15. Chance Level makes the bonus more likely. Very high volatility, 1,500x max, 96.13% RTP. Simple reels, but wins come in bursts.
pros: Free demo available on the Wazdan website
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
